questions.prompt: Ntibazagaruka ejo. Ni bagaruka, ntibazaguma ino, ahubwo bazasubira i Kigali
questions.answer: They will not return tomorrow. When/if they return, they will not remain here but will go back to Kigali.
We will certainly not see them. We will not help them.

questions.prompt: Mbese ntuzabikora ejo? Oya, ndabikora none. Sinshaka kubikora ubundi.
questions.answer: Will you not do it tomorrow? No, I will do it today. I don't want to do it some other day.

questions.prompt: Bariya bantu benshi ntibazakora ejo cyangwa ejo bundi.
questions.answer: Those (many) people will not work tomorrow or the day after tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Sinzava mu mujyi kuko nkunda kuba ino.
questions.answer: I will not leave the city because I like to live here.

questions.prompt: Ntimuzi guteka nka Abanyarwanda kuko muri abazungu.
questions.answer: Yo don't know how to cook like the Banyarwanda because you are white people.

questions.prompt: Ntabwo azamufasha. Nanjye sinzamufasha. Abandi bakwiriye kubikora.
questions.answer: He will never help her. And I will not help her. Others will have to do it.
You will not be afraid. Your friend will not punish you.
We will not be jealous because we love her very much.
